gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.kort.10: Buckets off, to the Bubble Bowl
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.10: Bikini Bottom is walking around wearing Plankmika's bucket helmets! Blow the buckets off their heads with your bubble blower and walk to the Bubble Bowl.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.10_b: A few more buckets! Then hurry to the stage of the Bubble Bowl.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.11: Climb onto the stage of the Bubble Bowl. Time for the biggest song Bikini Bottom ever heard.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.9: Walk to the pier of Shell City with the crown. Somebody very big is bobbing in the void there.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.nu.klaa: The crown is back, Mr. Krabguh has thawed and Spongeguh is manager. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.10: The Bubble Bowl, the stadium in the north of Bikini Bottom
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_kroon.waar.11: The stage of the Bubble Bowl
